mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate carisoprodol's CNS depression and increase risk of adverse effects including muscle weakness and metabolic complications.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and CNS effects closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
